_readme: Recipient for machine-drafted citizen objection emails (scripts/actions/draft_objection.mjs).
The project deliberately ships this as null: we do not publish unverified municipal addresses.
Set defaultRecipient to an address you have verified on cheyennecity.org (e.g. the City Clerk's
office or the committee's published contact), or pass --to explicitly. Until then the sync
pipeline succeeds and simply skips draft generation with a warning.
